title: 第264章 一比一，打平
slug: 德黑兰杂货铺我的情报明码标价
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

哈桑早就憋了一肚子火，听到队长发话，大步流星地走到射击位置，和雷子并排站立。

他从架子上扯下一把HK416。

这玩意儿，他们常用。

直接拉动枪栓，子弹上膛。

雷子偏过头，看着哈桑这副气势汹汹的模样，嗤笑一声。

“火气这么大？”

“一会要是输给我这个打了两场的人，不知到时候你又会是什么反应。”

哈桑眼中闪过一抹红芒。

双手端着枪，枪托死死抵在右肩窝上，整个人像是一头蓄势待发的猎豹。

“准备靶子！”

苏莱曼冲着远处的人喊了一声。

巴扎尔甘的条件有限，弄不出那种全自动的电子移动靶。

拉明之前带人搞了个简易的滑轨，两头绑着绳子，人在掩体后面拽着跑，靶子就在一百米开外的土坡前面横向移动。

速度忽快忽慢，全看拉绳子的人怎么发力。

这种野路子搞出来的移动靶，其实比正规靶场的更难打，因为毫无规律可言。

张剑站在不远处，双手抱在胸前，饶有兴致地看着场中两人。

赵平安凑近了一点，压低声音。

“张剑，这把怎么说？”

张剑摇了摇头，视线停在哈桑身上。

“不好说。”

“拔枪速射拼的是肌肉记忆和反应速度，雷子受过极其严格的系统训练，亚辛输在这一点上不冤。”

“但一百米移动靶，还是这种毫无规律的滑轨靶，拼的可就不是肌肉记忆了。”

张剑指了指哈桑那略微前倾的站姿。

“哈桑跟着苏莱曼在在中东摸爬滚打这么多年，打的最多的其实就是移动目标。”

“这种乱局里练出来的枪感，有时候比正规训练出来的更加有感觉。”

赵平安听完，若有所思地点了点头，视线重新投向射击位。

孙跃看两人都做好了准备，举起手。

“十发子弹，打完为止。”

“三。”

“二。”

“一。”

“开始！”

手起，令下。

远处的土坡前，一个人形钢靶猛地从左侧的掩体后窜了出来，顺着滑轨向右侧飞速移动。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Hassan had already been holding back his anger. When he heard the captain's words, he strode to the shooting position and stood side by side with Lei Zi.

He pulled a HK416 off the shelf.

They often use this stuff.

Pull the bolt directly to load the bullet.

Lei Zi tilted his head, looked at Hassan's menacing look, and sneered.

"So angry?"

"If you lose to me, who has played twice, I don't know how you will react."

A flash of red flashed in Hassan's eyes.

Holding the gun in both hands, the butt of the gun was firmly pressed against the right shoulder. The whole figure looked like a cheetah ready to go.

"Prepare the target!"

Suleiman shouted to the people in the distance.

Bazargan's conditions were limited and he couldn't make a fully automatic electronic moving target.

Laming had previously led people to build a simple slide rail with ropes tied at both ends. The people were dragged behind the bunker and ran, while the target moved laterally in front of the slope a hundred meters away.

The speed may be fast or slow, depending on the strength of the person pulling the rope.

This kind of moving target made by wild people is actually more difficult to hit than the one at the regular shooting range, because there is no pattern at all.

Zhang Jian stood not far away, with his hands folded in front of his chest, looking at the two people in the field with interest.

Zhao Pingan came closer and lowered his voice.

"Zhang Jian, what do you say about this one?"

Zhang Jian shook his head and his eyes stopped on Hassan.

"It's hard to say."

"The key to drawing a gun and shooting quickly is muscle memory and reaction speed. Lei Zi has received extremely strict systematic training. Yasin is not unjust in losing on this point."

"But the 100-meter moving target is still this kind of irregular sliding target, and the battle is not about muscle memory."

Zhang Jian pointed at Hassan's slightly forward posture.

"Hassan has followed Suleiman in the Middle East for so many years, and the thing he fought most was actually moving targets."

"The gun sense developed in this kind of chaos is sometimes more effective than that obtained through formal training."

After hearing this, Zhao Pingan nodded thoughtfully and turned his eyes to the shooting position again.

Seeing that both of them were ready, Sun Yue raised his hands.

"Ten rounds of bullets, until they run out."

"Three."

"Two."

"One."

"Start!"

Hands up, orders given.

In front of the slope in the distance, a human-shaped steel target suddenly jumped out from behind the bunker on the left and moved rapidly to the right along the slide rail.
